blocks.text:
While in Búzios you have free time to fill as you wish.

Buzios - This fishing village, 177 km north of Rio de Janeiro, is one of the most beautiful and little-known beach resorts in the world. The intimate feel, mild climate, exotic vegetation and picture-perfect beaches give this place a unique charm. The golden sands and crystal clear oceans offer incredible vistas of green mountains and rocky cliffs, with each beach boasting a truly stunning sunset, As well as relaxing by the sea, surfing, scuba diving, water skiing and kayaking are all popular activities here. The many piers leading onto the water are the perfect place to relax with great food and some cold beer and enjoy the laid-back atmosphere of Búzios. One unmissable activity is to take a trip out to sea with a fisherman and witness the jawdropping amount of marine wildlife underwater, such as turtles, tropical fish and even whales. Chic restaurants and stylish bars open their doors as the sun goes down and the cobbled streets fill up with people enjoying their evening. 

*Optionally  you can choose any other resort in Brazil for a beach holiday! 

The incredible beauty of the famous resorts in the North-East of Brazil (2-3h flight from Rio de Janeiro): Porto de Galinhas,Pipa, El Salvador, Jericoacoara Aquiraz, Porto Seguro, Trancoso. They   are for lovers of authentic Brazilian flavor and  luxurious tropical beaches with transparent water!
Rocky shore and sailboats in Guanabara Bay, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
